Articles L. 151-30 to L. 151-33 of the Code de l'urbanisme (cross-reference in 12.4.3) are not in this document.

notes: According to sub-item 9.2, spaces on slabs (espaces sur dalle) are not considered open ground (pleine terre), even if covered with topsoil.

Sub-item 13.1.3 stipulates that existing wooded areas within the protection perimeter of the Boulevard du Général de Gaulle ecological corridor must be maintained or replaced by an equivalent wooded area with diversified local species.

Sub-item 13.3 details specific rules for Protected Green Spaces (Espaces Verts Protégés - EVP) marked on the zoning map, requiring prior authorization for modifications and preservation of ecological continuity.
